ui.title: Pokémon Type Effectiveness Calculator | Tera Raid + Dual-Type Defense + Matrix Filter
ui.subtitle: Dual-Type Defense · Tera Raid Tactics · Reverse Warning · Matrix Filter
ui.resist_footnote: Reverse warning: shows if a type is countered by the defender's original (and Tera) types.
ui.resist_footnote2: After Terastallization, the original type list still warns based on both original and Tera types.
ui.tera_note_header: Terastallization replaces the defending type with the Tera type, independent of original types.
ui.tera_footnote: After Terastallization, the Pokémon's type becomes its Tera type; original types no longer affect defense.
ui.tera_footnote2: Reverse warning: shows if a type is countered by the original or Tera types.
ui.matrix_footnote: Based on Gen VIII/IX standard type chart · Dual-type effectiveness multiplies (0 if immune)
ui.matrix_footnote2: Terastallization replaces the defending type, providing independent effectiveness reference + reverse warning
ui.matrix_footnote3: Click 'Focus Key Types' to show only current defending (and Tera) types as attacker rows.
ui.empty_matrix: Please select at least one type to filter
ui.empty_tera: Select a Tera type to see its defensive effectiveness
